prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny harbour quay of pale stone with a waist-high iron railing, mooring posts of normal height and a white lighthouse behind her, softly lit by blue-hour twilight and warm lamps, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in blue-hour twilight with warm lamps glowing, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Latina woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a fiery, passionate expression, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large silver hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a lead small flared temple bell, an iron chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a tin teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver ship's anchor, a bronze barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a silver cube-shaped block, a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three platinum bracelets. Extra long nails in matching polished black granite.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and powerful athletic woman, far beyond any real person; wide capped boulder-like shoulders, a broad flaring back and lats forming a dramatic V-taper, defined muscular arms, a firm chest, a deeply defined six-pack abdomen on a very narrow waist, round firm hips and strong muscular thighs with a visible quad sweep and defined calves; hard clean muscle under glowing skin, not bulky like a bodybuilder, not thin; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: full body polished black granite fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep charcoal-black granite surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID silver mineral fleck detail glinting through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Her face stays real living skin and the stone ends cleanly at the neck.
LEFT Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme thigh-high platform stiletto boots carved from the same black granite, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Extra long nails in matching polished jade.
RIGHT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: full body polished jade-green stone fused directly to his own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid stone curving to follow his body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep jade-green stone surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID pale-green cloudy vein striations flowing through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Background & Lighting: each material catching the twilight and the warm lamp light in soft glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
